title: Black Friday in Swedish: 3 Phrases for the Shop Counter | SvenskaVardag
text:
Shopping on Black Friday in Sweden? 🛍️ Learn how to ask if something is on sale, check that your card works, and get your receipt.

🎓 på rea = on sale.

👉 Follow @svenskavardag for a little Swedish every day. Share this with a friend who is learning Swedish.
